en.headline: All tropical cyclone signals cancelled as Saudel weakens
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled every tropical cyclone warning signal at 12.10am after Tropical Depression Saudel weakened into a low-pressure area over inland Guangdong.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled all tropical cyclone warning signals at 12.10am on Friday. Tropical Depression Saudel had weakened into a low-pressure area over the inland areas of Guangdong.

The Standby Signal No. 1 had been in force through Thursday evening while Saudel tracked west-southwest across eastern Guangdong and continued to lose intensity. At around 11pm on Thursday the system was still classified as a tropical depression centred roughly 260 kilometres north-northeast of Hong Kong.

With the system no longer posing a direct tropical-cyclone threat, the Observatory said the signals were no longer required. Local winds may still be occasionally strong offshore and on high ground under the residual influence of the low-pressure area and the northeast monsoon. Members of the public were advised to remain alert to the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 沙德爾減弱為低壓區 所有熱帶氣旋警告信號取消
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨12時10分取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾已在廣東內陸減弱為低壓區。
body: 香港天文台於今日（4日）凌晨12時10分取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號。熱帶低氣壓沙德爾已在廣東內陸減弱為低壓區。
一號戒備信號於周四晚間仍維持生效，當時沙德爾向西南偏西橫過廣東東部內陸並持續減弱。周四晚上約11時，系統仍屬熱帶低氣壓，集結於本港東北偏北約260公里。
天文台表示，系統已不再構成直接熱帶氣旋威脅，故無需繼續發出警告信號。受低壓區餘勢及東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中仍可能吹強風。市民應繼續留意最新天氣資訊。
